summary: The GR engine runs the compute job on the GK110B (GR is the engine name in Nouveau; it also does 3D drawing). Two controllers inside it, FECS for the hub and GPCCS for each GPC, run the microcode of task C2. gf100_gr_init starts the engine: it sets up MMU forwarding, applies the register tables in mmio, calls the init hooks of the function table in order and enables exception reporting. For each channel a context image (grctx) is generated from tables of register writes and from the grctx functions. The zbc members keep the table of clear values. For milestone S3 the Haiku driver has to reproduce init with its hooks, the microcode load, and the generation of one context image; which hooks a compute-only driver may leave out (zcull and the two ROP hooks set up drawing units) is not established.
